title.narrative: Contribute to Sudans democratic transition by bridging the gap between citizens and the media

description.narrative: Since the interests and needs of young people are poorly represented in the media, CFI will support new media initiatives that will result in the production of online media content that gives a voice to and promotes a more active role of young people (especially in underrepresented areas) and/or in the development/improvement of media platforms that allow them to get involved in public debate at a local or national level. Next to providing financial support to the selected media outlets, groups of journalists, bloggers and/or journalists clubs and associations that work on media issues, CFI will support the grantees of said funding scheme through a comprehensive capacity building programme tailored to specific levels of experience and specialisation of the trainees/grantees. In this way, the people behind these selected media projects will be supported not only financially, but also accompanied in the implementation of the subgrants, whereby CFI ensures that the information and analytical products supported by the subgrants are of good quality.

title.narrative: Bertelsmann Transformation Index (BTI) Political Transformation Index value

description.narrative: The Bertelsmann Transformation Index (BTI) analyzes transformation processes toward democracy and a market economy in international comparison and identifies successful strategies for peaceful change.The BTI Political transformation index is related to the state of political transformation in a country. It consists of five criteria, which in turn are derived from expert assessments in 18 indicators. the BTI concept of democracy goes beyond free elections and political participation. It includes the functioning of the rule of law and stateness as well as the acceptance, representation and political culture of the democratic system. (Scale of 1 to 10)

comment.narrative: BTI Political Transformation Index score 2.02 hard line autocracy rank 134.
Increase in the respective indicators 202

VDem Democracy Indices and Indicators include macrolevel indices that describe features of democracy at various levels (overall, midlevel and lowerlevel indices), as well as indicators that address very specific features of political systems.

title.narrative: SO2 Strengthen local journalism as well as the collaboration between journalists and civil society, by strengthening professionalisation and promoting mutual understanding.

description.narrative: The project will train a group of selected journalists from the regions and financially support the production of innovative content by them, while also encouraging collaboration between these journalists, as well as between journalists and civil society representatives. The supply of information is disconnected from young citizens demands and expectations: the media in the regions mainly deal with national political and institutional news. Little quality content is accessible on the subjects of daily concern to citizens, such as issues related to the economy, the environment, sociocultural life, nor is information on local issues available despite young (and older) peoples desire to know what is happening in the cities or regions, some of which are inaccessible to the population. Journalists travel very little in their regions i.e. outside the regional capitals, and give limited space to cover the needs and interests of the citizens living there. Even the news of civil society (NGOs, etc.) is treated by most of the media in the region from an institutional angle. This feeds frustrations and leads to low levels of trust between the media and their audience.
